slides.h1: Inherited Money and Earned Money Are Not the Same House
slides.sub: The 2nd and 11th houses describe two different relationships with money.

slides.body: This is a behaviour framework, not a prediction or a stock pick. No placement or dasha guarantees a financial outcome.
Dhana bhava — the house of stored resources. It shows family wealth patterns, savings habits and how you relate to what is already yours.
Labha bhava — the house of gains. It shows income from your own effort, your network, and how fresh money arrives.

points: Strong 2nd, weak 11th: comfortable base, little new income
Weak 2nd, strong 11th: money arrives but does not stay
Reading only one house misses half the picture
Check each house's lord, planets in it and aspects

slides.body: Match the habit to the gap. Strong inflow but poor retention? Automate saving on payday. Strong base but low inflow? Fund one deliberate income-building effort.
Dasha (planetary period) of the 2nd or 11th lord tends to bring that theme to the foreground. It shows when the habit matters most, not what will happen.
